## AVerMedia D133 Series - Storage & SD Card Support

### D133
- **Storage:** 1x M.2 Key M 2280 for NVMe SSD (primary storage). Also 1x M.2 Key E 2230, but that is for WiFi, not storage. No eMMC or SATA interfaces listed.

- **Storage:** 1x M.2 Key M 2280 for NVMe SSD (primary storage). Also 1x M.2 Key E 2230 for WiFi (not storage). No eMMC or SATA listed.
- **SD Card:** No. No microSD/SD card slot documented.
- **Source:** https://professional.avermedia.com/product-detail/D133-1

### D133S
- **Storage:** 1x M.2 Key M 2280 for NVMe SSD (primary storage). Also 1x M.2 Key E 2230 for WiFi (not storage). No eMMC or SATA listed.
- **SD Card:** No. No microSD/SD card reader present.
- **Source:** https://professional.avermedia.com/product-detail/D133S

## Key findings
- All three variants share the same storage architecture: a single M.2 Key M (2280) slot for NVMe SSD as the primary/onboard storage path, plus an M.2 Key E (2230) slot reserved for WiFi/wireless modules (not usable as storage).

- No explicit NVMe capacity limits are stated on the product pages; capacity is determined by the M.2 2280 NVMe drive you install.

## Overview
AVerMedia's D131 Carrier board equips powerful NVIDIA® Jetson Orin NX/ Xavier™ NX/ Nano modules. This efficient system-on-module (SoM) opens new worlds of embedded IoT applications with full analytic capabilities.

## Purpose and Design
AVerMedia D131 is designed for the industry applications with spatial concern and feature a rich assortment of I/O ports for rapid AI-based solution development and seamless deployment as required by demanding business applications.

## Key Specifications
D131 provides one HDMI video output, four USB 3.1 ports, one GbE RJ-45 port (Option POE), 40-pin expansion header, and one Micro-B USB 2.0 port for recovery.

## Support and Customization
AVerMedia supports businesses of all sizes and offers customizable BSP services, flexible MoQ, in addition to NVIDIA's JetPackTM SDK.

**Note:** D131 have one mSD slot, but NVIDIA Orin NX/Orin Nano doesn't support mSD function. All specifications are subject to change without prior notice.

The official product page is available at professional.avermedia.com, which you can visit for the complete and most up-to-date specifications.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about the AVerMedia NX215 carrier board and its storage specifications:

## Storage and microSD Support

The NX215 Carrier board includes 1x micro-SD card slot (only for NX/TX2 NX/Nano). This means that while the board supports a microSD card slot, it's important to note that this feature is not available for the Orin Nano or Orin NX modules specifically—the microSD slot is only functional with the Xavier NX, TX2 NX, and Nano modules.

## General Specifications

The NX215 supports NVIDIA® Jetson Orin NX/Orin Nano/Xavier™ NX/TX2 NX/Nano modules and features 2x 2 Lane MIPI CSI-2 Camera Input, 1x 4 Lane MIPI CSI-2 Camera Input (only for NX/TX2 NX/Nano), 2x GbE RJ-45 with 20-pins expansion header, 3x USB 3.0, 2x 4Kp60 HDMI outputs (Nano/Orin NX/Orin Nano support 1x HDMI), and 2x M.2 for WIFI and SSD.

The board also has an operating temperature range of 0°C ~ 70°C with dimensions of W: 120mm x L: 90mm x H:26.5mm.

Research complete. Here is the structured summary per model.

## AVerMedia Jetson Orin NX Carrier Boards — Storage & SD Card

### D131
- **Storage:** 1x M.2 Key M 2280 slot for NVMe SSD; 1x M.2 Key E 2230 slot for Wi-Fi module. No eMMC or SATA.
- **SD Card:** Yes — one microSD (mSD) slot is physically present, BUT non-functional with Orin NX/Orin Nano modules ("NVIDIA Orin NX/Orin Nano doesn't support mSD function. It's SOM limitation").
- **Source:** https://professional.avermedia.com/product-detail/D131

### D131L
- **Storage:** 1x M.2 Key M 2280 slot for NVMe SSD; 1x M.2 Key E 2230 slot for Wi-Fi (AC9260). No eMMC or SATA.
- **SD Card:** No microSD/SD card slot is listed on the product page for the D131L. (Note: the D131 series shares a chassis, but the L variant's spec table does not enumerate a microSD slot — treat as not documented/absent.)
- **Source:** https://professional.avermedia.com/product-detail/D131L

### D131S
- **Storage:** 1x M.2 Key M 2280 slot for NVMe SSD; 1x M.2 Key E 2230 slot (Wi-Fi/capture). No eMMC or SATA.
- **SD Card:** Yes — one microSD slot present, but non-functional with Orin NX/Orin Nano ("SOM limitation").
- **Source:** https://professional.avermedia.com/product-detail/D131S

### NX215
- **Storage:** 1x M.2 Key M 2280 slot for NVMe SSD; 1x M.2 Key E 2230 slot for Wi-Fi module. No eMMC or SATA.
- **SD Card:** Yes — one microSD card slot present, but "not for Orin NX/Orin Nano" (only functional with Xavier NX, TX2 NX, and Nano modules).
- **Source:** https://professional.avermedia.com/product-detail/NX215

### Key cross-model finding
All four boards use the same storage architecture: a single **M.2 Key M 2280 NVMe SSD** slot as primary storage plus an M.2 Key E 2230 Wi-Fi slot; none support eMMC or SATA. Every board that exposes a microSD slot (D131, D131S, NX215) explicitly notes it is **non-functional on Orin NX/Orin Nano** modules due to the module (SOM) itself, not the carrier board. The D131L product page does not list a microSD slot at all.
